nasa_apod.title: A Treasure Chest in the Carina Nebula
nasa_apod.explanation: This treasure chest is full of stars.   The featured image was obtained with NASA's James Webb Space Telescope and shows a dust pilar in the Carina Nebula inside our Galaxy, roughly 7500 light-years away.   It is formed by interstellar gas and dust, and shaped by powerful stellar winds and radiation...
